title: SagesCraft Modpack
description: A vanilla modpack made by the SagestCraft team.  *Its for the SagesCraft server but you can use it for other stuff too!*
body:
# Hey, first of all, Yes you can still use this even if your not playing on the server!

Anyways, This modpack is a collection of optimisation mods, QOL and some other rather helpful inventory for content creators. I made this so that all people can use this modpack (im trying to be a content creator but am very terrible lmao).

Also note: This modpack does not have any types of cheats under any circumstances. Infact all mods included in this (technical project) are from the modrinth pages itself.

Please link back to this page when you want to share this modpack! Would really apreciate it.

Anyways this is the SagesCraft team and RavengerBuster signing off.
